newsitem.title: CROATIA: Blast destroys Croatian war memorial.
newsitem.headline: Blast destroys Croatian war memorial.

text.p: A World War Two memorial has been blown up near the Croatian town of Knin, the former capital of the rebel Serb Krajina enclave, the Croatian state news agency HINA reported on Wednesday.

One person was slightly injured in the blast on Tuesday night by debris from the monument, which commemorated the struggle against the Nazis led by communist Josip Broz Tito, HINA quoted police as saying.
The Nazis fostered a separate Croatian Fascist state during World War Two. Many Croat nationalists equate Tito's anti-Nazi struggle with the inclusion of their country in a Serb-dominated Yugoslavia.
Croatian forces regained controlled of Krajina in August last year. HINA gave no indication of who was responsible but said an investigation was under way.
